text: The registered result supports the primary claim only under stated limits, with one provider and one stipulated environment, conditional on a stated payoff objective, and with the bounty hypothesis not supported.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Should an Intelligent Agent Have Legal Rights? (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7596939

isBasedOn.name: Should an Intelligent Agent Have Legal Rights?

abstract: Should intelligent agents have legal rights? This Article sets that question aside and asks a smaller one that matters more in practice. An intelligent agent that earns a reputation record has something to lose.

additionalProperty.value: The merged registered result is therefore support for the primary claim with one provider and one stipulated environment, conditional on a stated payoff objective, with the bounty hypothesis not supported.
